mapper.sql: meeting_id meetingId, meeting_code meetingCode, meeting_name meetingName, meeting_type meetingType, project_id projectId, project_name projectName, audit_id auditId, workflow_id workflowId, meeting_time meetingTime, meeting_end_time meetingEndTime, meeting_place meetingPlace, online_url onlineUrl, host_unit hostUnit, organize_unit organizeUnit, meeting_topic meetingTopic, agenda, notice_content noticeContent, notice_time noticeTime, status, archive_status archiveStatus, archive_time archiveTime, remark, create_by createBy, create_time createTime, update_by updateBy, update_time updateTime
mapper.select: select from rail_meeting where meeting_id = #{meetingId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into rail_meeting ( meeting_code, meeting_name, meeting_type, project_id, project_name, audit_id, workflow_id, meeting_time, meeting_end_time, meeting_place, online_url, host_unit, organize_unit, meeting_topic, agenda, notice_content, status, remark, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{meetingCode}, #{meetingName}, #{meetingType}, #{projectId}, #{projectName}, #{auditId}, #{workflowId}, #{meetingTime}, #{meetingEndTime}, #{meetingPlace}, #{onlineUrl}, #{hostUnit}, #{organizeUnit}, #{meetingTopic}, #{agenda}, #{noticeContent}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update rail_meeting set status = #{status}, notice_content = #{noticeContent}, notice_time = sysdate(), archive_status = #{archiveStatus}, archive_time = sysdate(), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where meeting_id = #{meetingId}
mapper.select: select participant_id participantId, meeting_id meetingId, user_id userId, participant_name participantName, unit_name unitName, duty, phone, email, participant_role participantRole, sign_status signStatus, sign_time signTime, sign_remark signRemark, create_by createBy, create_time createTime, update_by updateBy, update_time updateTime from rail_meeting_participant where meeting_id = #{meetingId} order by participant_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into rail_meeting_participant ( meeting_id, user_id, participant_name, unit_name, duty, phone, email, participant_role, sign_status, sign_time, sign_remark, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{meetingId}, #{userId}, #{participantName}, #{unitName}, #{duty}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{participantRole}, coalesce(#{signStatus}, '0'), #{signTime}, #{signRemark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.select: select file_id fileId, meeting_id meetingId, file_type fileType, file_name fileName, stored_name storedName, file_path filePath, file_size fileSize, mime_type mimeType, description, create_by createBy, create_time createTime, update_by updateBy, update_time updateTime from rail_meeting_file where meeting_id = #{meetingId} and del_flag = '0' order by create_time desc, file_id desc

select file_id fileId, meeting_id meetingId, file_type fileType, file_name fileName, stored_name storedName, file_path filePath, file_size fileSize, mime_type mimeType, description, create_by createBy, create_time createTime from rail_meeting_file where file_id = #{fileId} and del_flag = '0'

mapper.select: select minutes_id minutesId, meeting_id meetingId, minutes_title minutesTitle, minutes_content minutesContent, compile_user_id compileUserId, compile_by compileBy, compile_time compileTime, confirm_status confirmStatus, confirm_user_id confirmUserId, confirm_by confirmBy, confirm_time confirmTime, confirm_opinion confirmOpinion, create_by createBy, create_time createTime, update_by updateBy, update_time updateTime from rail_meeting_minutes where meeting_id = #{meetingId} order by minutes_id desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into rail_meeting_minutes ( meeting_id, minutes_title, minutes_content, compile_user_id, compile_by, compile_time, confirm_status, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{meetingId}, #{minutesTitle}, #{minutesContent}, #{compileUserId}, #{compileBy}, sysdate(), coalesce(#{confirmStatus}, '0'), #{createBy}, sysdate() )

mapper.insert: insert into rail_meeting_issue ( meeting_id, issue_title, issue_content, issue_type, risk_level, responsible_unit, responsible_user, due_time, status, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{meetingId}, #{issueTitle}, #{issueContent}, #{issueType}, #{riskLevel}, #{responsibleUnit}, #{responsibleUser}, #{dueTime}, #{status}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
